memoryMeaning: Maximum resident bytes measured separately per process, including graph/lowering/operand compilation, native hashes and prover. Tracked dense/stream payloads are implementation buffer ceilings, exclude caller-owned relation and opaque native hash internals, and are not process RSS. Streaming retains a source value table and one six-factor row; compiled sparse relation and descriptor remain resident.
